messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — collecting a few specific clarifying Qs so leadership answers are in one place. Short replies appreciated.

anya: 1) One-line mission for customer-facing docs? We want something crisp for website hero.

rachel: "Make inference predictable, fast, and cost-effective across any environment." Keeps 'inference' front-and-center and hints at multi-deployment.

liam: Slight variant for sales decks: "A single inference platform that delivers predictable latency, transparent unit economics, and flexible deployment options."

anya: 2) Messaging vs "build your own" — what's the single strongest argument?

nisha: Time-to-production + ops overhead. Most teams underestimate the months of engineering and ongoing SRE cost to hit p95 SLOs and keep costs reasonable. We should pair that claim with a simple TCO example (e.g., 3-engineer-year vs our managed path).

rachel: Also highlight risk: silent regressions in quality after quantization/ops changes. Our eval + rollback tooling prevents customer-facing regressions.

anya: 3) Competitors: how direct should we be calling out cloud AI endpoints and open runtime vendors?

liam: Be explicit in product docs: "vs Cloud AI" -> focus on operational levers and predictable economics; "vs self-hosted runtimes" -> focus on orchestration, autoscale, and auditability. Avoid naming vendor X in top-of-funnel content, but have an FAQ with direct comparisons.

anya: 4) For the next 90 days, what's the one product priority that best signals we're executing on the strategy?

liam: Shipping the persona->deployment playbook (hosted/dedicated/private) + benchmark harness that customers can run. If we can get two anonymized customer benchmark stories, that materially helps sales conversions.

nisha: From GTM, short term signal is shortened sales cycles on Dedicated deals and a repeatable pilot offering.

anya: 5) What metrics should the company homepage show (or we can publicize) without oversharing internal SLAs?

rachel: Public: average p95 latency example (on standard prompt size), model catalog breadth, and per-token cost ranges for reference configs. Internal: p95 SLO attainment, net revenue retention, time-to-first-successful-call for new customers.

anya: Thanks. One last practical Q: can we publish a 1-page FAQ / blog from this thread? Minimal, public-friendly.

rachel: Yes, go ahead. Keep it < 600 words, include one concrete anonymized benchmark, and link to our 'how we measure latency & cost' appendix. nisha: I'll coordinate with marketing on voice and legal for anonymization.

sales-bot: Reminder: all-hands recording + slides uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/all-hands/3176543210 (slides: persona playbook draft attached).

anya: Great closing this thread after follow-ups; tagging owners: @liam (playbook), @nisha (benchmarks/marketing). Appreciate rapid replies! :sparkles:
